title: AttachmentEventLog - Data API
description: Attachment event logs contain information about attachments. This object is available in API version 65.0 and later.

ContentType.description: The content type of the attachment.

IsPrivateOn.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsPrivateOn.description: Whether the attachment is flagged as private or not. The default value is false.

OperationType.description: The operation type of the attachment.

ParentIdentifier.description: The ID of the parent object of the attachment. For example, a07EE00001LgsUH

RequestIdentifier.description: The unique ID of a single transaction. A transaction can contain one or more events. Each event in a given transaction has the same REQUEST_ID.

Timestamp.description: The access time of Salesforce services in GMT. For example, 2020-01-20T19:12:26.965Z. Milliseconds are the most granular setting.

UserIdentifier.description: The 15-character ID of the user who’s using Salesforce services through the UI or the API. For example: 00530000009M943.

special_access_rules: To access this object, you must have the View Event Log Object Data user permission.
